messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I've found your line (555-123-2002) and enabled international roaming on our side. I also see that your plan (Premium Plan) has a 15 GB monthly data limit, and you've used 15.1 GB — so you've exceeded your data limit. This means your mobile data connectivity is currently blocked until you either:
- Refuel data (up to 2 GB at $2/GB), or
- Change to a plan with more data.

Before we proceed with refueling or plan change, let's first address the device-side issues you mentioned (2G network, mobile data off, roaming off). Since you're abroad, you'll need:
1) Enable mobile data on your phone
2) Enable data roaming on your phone
3) Change network mode from 2G to 4G/5G preferred

Let's start by guiding you through these steps on your device. Please perform the following actions in order:

1) Turn ON mobile data: use `toggle_data()` to enable mobile data.
2) Turn ON data roaming: use `toggle_roaming()` to enable data roaming.
3) Change network mode to 4G/5G: use `set_network_mode_preference(mode="4g_5g_preferred")`.

After completing these, please let me know and we'll check if mobile data works, then address the MMS-specific settings (APN/MMSC, etc.) and also resolve the data limit issue.

I have turned on mobile data and data roaming on your phone, and changed the network mode to 4G/5G preferred. The status bar now shows excellent 5G signal with data enabled. Would you like me to check if you can now send an MMS message?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
